simple.meaning: עָתַק (ʻâthaq) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to remove (intransitive or transitive) figuratively, to grow old ; specifically, to transcribe.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 9 times across Genesis, Job, Psalms, Proverbs, beginning at Genesis 12:8. Its contexts include altar, land, mountain.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עָתַק (H6275).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: עָתַק (ʻâthaq) / H6275 is traced through Genesis 12:8, Genesis 26:22, Job 9:5, Job 14:18 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.short: to remove (intransitive or transitive) figuratively, to grow old ; specifically, to transcribe
definitions.usage: copy out, leave off, become (wax) old, remove.
definitions.full: H6275. atheq [ עָתֵק ] verb move, proceed, advance (Late Hebrew Hiph`il; Assyrian etêku as H., also transitive bring, move ; Arabic , precede, pass forth, become free, grow old ; Aramaic , עֲתַק grow old , Palmyrene adjective עתק old ); — Qal Perfect 3feminine singular עָֽתְקָה Psa 6:8 , 3 plural עָֽתְקוּ Job 21:7 ; Imperfect 3masculine singular יֶעְתַּק 14:18 ; 18:4 ; — 1 move יֶע ׳וְצוּר מִמְּקֹמוֺ Job 14:18 , so 18:4 . 2 advance (in years; Aramaic sense) Job 21:7 (|| יִחְיוּ ); hence = grow old and weak Psa 6:8 (of eye, || עָֽשְׁשָׁה ). Hiph`il Perfect 3plural הֶעְתִּיקוּ Job 32:16 (Gi; van d. H. Baer 32:15 ), Prov 25:1 ; Imperfect 3masculine singular וַיַּעְתֵּק Gen 12:8 ; 26:22 ; Participle מַעְתִּיק Job 9:5 ; — 1 move forward (that is, tent) = proceed Gen 12:8 ( ה מִשָּׁם, locative), 26:22 ( מִשָּׁם ); so figurative Job 32:16 (see above) words have moved away from them ( מֵהֶם ), but see probably gloss (Bu and others). 2 Job 9:5 he who removeth mountains . 3 very late Prov 25:1 transcribe ( remove from one book or roll to another; ᵐ5 ἐξεγράψαντο , ᵑ9 transtulerunt ; so in mediaeval Hebrew: Zunz ZMG xxv (1871), 447 f. = Ges. Schr. iii. 66 f. ).
